overview.about: The Butterfield Bermuda Championship is a PGA Tour event at the government-owned Port Royal Golf Course, perched on the Atlantic cliffs of Bermuda. Ocean wind is the course's main defence, and the spectacular par-3 16th plays right along the sea.
overview.nextEvent: The next Butterfield Bermuda Championship is played at Port Royal in Bermuda. The exposed clifftop layout and swirling ocean breezes make scoring highly weather-dependent.
